title: Subscribe
text: Receive messages from ROS network, 2 outputs, {Topic source} sets Source for specifying topic name Select from ROS network; {Topic}, {Message type} sets the rOS message type string, {Sample time} sets the interval between outputs and {Length of subscribe callback queue} sets the message queue length. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Topic source
params.values: Source for specifying topic name Select from ROS network | Specify your own

params.name: Topic
params.values: Topic name to subscribe to string
